parameters.datum: A instrument mounting surface Z0; STEP Y=-logical drawing Y
parameters.cup_floor_note: R4.1b: floor top -20.30 -> -20.25 (battery bottom insulator 0.10 -> 0.05 PET; battery bottom stays -20.20) and floor 0.60 -> 0.55: cup bottom -20.90 -> -20.80 closes worst-case total height (tolerance-stack chain 1)
parameters.jack_shoulder_gap_note: zero-gap design; 0.005 CAD offset only avoids coplanar boolean slivers on the vendor B-spline face

usb_clamp_post.why: R4.1c: (88,22) Ø4.4 left 0.35 to J3408 (COVER6) pads on the cover board; now 0.75 to the pads and 0.68 to the PWR_PB track

parameters.sensor_board: eliminated (ECO L-12, TMP117 on main B side)
parameters.battery_top_foam: 1.0 mm PORON 4701-30 class strips, fills swell allowance; ~50% compressible
parameters.instrument_screw: ST2.2x6.5 A2 stainless pan-head wood screw (non-magnetic), pilot 1.6x5 in wood, 0.15 N.m; threaded insert in wood preferred
parameters.internal_screw: M1.6 thread-forming screw for plastics (PT/WN1452 type) into POM pilot 1.3; production PC/ABS: M1.6 heat-set brass insert
parameters.button_fit_basis: SKQGABE010 h1.5 +0.15/-0, travel0.25, 1.57N (native-components.json). Nub designed to max switch top2.15+0.05; trim stock blank to measured switch top+0.05
parameters.wheel_thumb_notch: north-edge notch 12 wide, floor Z1.5: knurled rim stands 1.5 above local floor (wheel top Z3.0 fixed by board stack)

snap_locating_rib.on: lower_cup inner wall at each snap flap root (4x)
snap_locating_rib.why: R4.1 tolerance stack: without ribs the cup floats +/-0.2 in Y between the blades and one-side hook engagement falls to 0.05 nominal / <0 worst case. Ribs on the cover blades were rejected: they would need wider cover-PCB snap slots (C4 sweep hit)

parameters.pickup_entry_xy_status: PLACEHOLDER. TODO(measure): original pickup-wire hole of the violin (DECISIONS addendum 2026-10-15: no new hole is drilled in the violin). Convert: X = 258 - u (u = distance from tail metal datum, mm), Y = 24.5 + v (v = offset from module centre line toward the Y=0 / wheel-notch edge negative). Then set this value and rebuild.
parameters.pickup_entry_slot_note: first-sample default: 10 x 3 slot along X (instrument length) centred on pickup_entry_xy; accepts the original hole anywhere within +/-3.5 mm along X; across (Y) the 3.0 width only accepts the cable (<= dia 2.6). Must stay in the north cable strip Y 3.1..6.3 (cup wall 2.8 / battery guide 6.5) so the cable reaches the main-board notch x58.8-62.4 and J101

usb_opening_collar.why: R4.1b: pocket depth 0.80 -> 0.95 closes worst-case USB-C depth with GCT +/-0.25 (chain 7d); collar restores the lateral bearing wall of the opening (0.35 roof + 0.7 collar)

parameters.usb_face_pocket_note: R4.1 widened 12.0 -> 13.0: USB Type-C plug overmold reference max 12.35 x 6.5 must reach the receptacle face 0.6 below roof top (tolerance-stack.md chain 7)
parameters.audio_frame_selective_fit: jack shoulder-pad loop is over-constrained (tolerance-stack.md chain 6); first sample: pick web 0.40/0.50/0.60 + 0.05 PET shims by measured gap
parameters.upper_and_cup_join: 4 zero-play snaps (window=hook+0.04); four upper screws attach instrument
parameters.process: CNC POM-C for dimensional prototype, or PA12 additive blank with post-machined precision datum/ledges; unverified fatigue/acoustics are first-article tests
parameters.factory_tuning: Main shims (ledge-shaped set) only when measured latch gap >0; do not compress pack or machine vendor parts
parameters.pending: Native board ECO (holes listed in pcb-interface-eco-R4.json) and final assembly collision rerun after board routing; worst-case/RSS stack done in tolerance-stack.md (R4.1): chains 4 (keys) and 6 (jack loop) close only with first-sample selective fit; Kycon/GCT title-block tolerances still to be obtained; pickup_entry_xy awaits measurement

shipping_packaging_removed: Only vendor third0.1mm Kapton shipping tape solid removed from installed reference.
